beta.title: Request beta access
beta.intro: Apply for a place in the uLiquid beta. Your account is created only after approval.
beta.motivation: What would you like to test? (max. 1,000 characters)
beta.privacy: We use your email and application to process your request and send verification and invitation emails. No newsletter subscription. Cloudflare Turnstile protects this form against automated abuse.
beta.error: The request could not be completed. Please wait and try again. If the link has expired, request a new one.
beta.sent: If this address is eligible, a confirmation email will arrive shortly. Please also check your spam folder.
beta.confirmed: Email confirmed. Your application is now awaiting review. We will email you if access is approved.
beta.created: Your account is ready. You can now sign in.
beta.provisioning: Your account has been created. Setup is still running; please try signing in again in a few minutes.
beta.invalidLink: This link is invalid, expired or has already been used. Request a new confirmation or contact support about your invitation.
beta.legalChanged: The conditions have changed. Reload the page, reopen your invitation from the email and review the current conditions.
beta.accept: I accept the Terms of Use and acknowledge the Privacy Policy and Risk & Non-Custody Notice, version {version}.
beta.notConfigured: Activation requires Turnstile keys, an allowed hostname, a valid web origin and approved privacy information.
beta.confirmAction: Confirm this action. Deleting a request removes its application data and links; it does not delete an existing account.
